module_catalog.name: Dissertation: Advanced research in Fine Arts  858
module_catalog.content: A dissertation on an approved topic completed under supervision of a supervisor.
module_catalog.prerequisites: A four-year degree in Fine Arts or equivalent qualification (with approval by Senate) with an average of at least 65%.

module_catalog.name: Dissertation and creative production 859
module_catalog.content: A solo exhibition of creative work investigating a relevant research theme/idea that has been meaningfully and appropriately delimited within contemporary discourses, accompanied by a dissertation of limited scope serving as a framing document and a catalogue for the exhibition. The creative work and the dissertation must be conceptually linked and integrated.
module_catalog.prerequisites: A four-year degree in Fine Arts or equivalent qualification (with approval by Senate) with an average of at least 65%

module_catalog.name: Dissertation and curatorial practice 860
module_catalog.content: A curated exhibition investigating a relevant research theme/idea that has been meaningfully and appropriately delimited to comply with contemporary requirements; a dissertation of limited scope which will serve as a framing document, and a catalogue for the exhibition. The area and topic for research are those that were delineated in the research proposal. The curated exhibition and the dissertation must be conceptually linked and integrated.
module_catalog.prerequisites: A four-year degree in Fine Arts or equivalent qualification (with approval by Senate) with an average of at least 65%.
